description: Land Title Settlement Department - Land Parcels, Kalutara Village, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District  - Cad. Map No. 530091 & other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and land registration processes across multiple districts. The content focuses exclusively on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) which includes land registrations, title settlements, and property ownership claims.
